title: Nvidia Faces Future Without Founder Amid Financial Success and Political Pressure
subtitle: The tech giant reports record-breaking profits while navigating a leadership crisis and national security concerns.

summary.en: Nvidia recently held its first earnings call since the resignation of long-time CEO Jensen Huang. Despite the leadership change, the company reported strong financial growth driven by the AI boom. The board of directors has confirmed they will not bring Huang back, despite his public interest in returning. Meanwhile, the company faces outside pressure regarding how its technology reached China. The business remains highly profitable, focusing on keeping its current momentum steady.
summary.zh: 輝達在長期執行長黃仁勳辭職後，近期舉行了首次財報電話會議。儘管領導層有所變動，受惠於人工智慧熱潮，公司仍繳出強勁的財務成長。董事會已確認不會讓黃仁勳回任，儘管他本人有回歸意願。同時，公司正面臨外界對於其技術如何流入中國的壓力。目前業務獲利依然豐厚，公司正致力於維持現有的成長動能。

paragraphs.en: Nvidia, the world-famous chip company, held its first earnings call since the sudden departure of its long-time leader, Jensen Huang. The company is currently led by interim CEO Colette Kress, who has served as the chief financial officer for many years. During the call, board chairman Harvey Jones worked to calm investors by confirming that the board unanimously accepted Huang’s resignation and has no plans to bring him back. This announcement followed a period of intense public speculation, including a "Stand with Jensen" campaign organized by his supporters.
paragraphs.zh: 全球知名的晶片公司輝達（Nvidia），在長期領導人黃仁勳（Jensen Huang）突然離職後，舉行了首次財報電話會議。該公司目前由擔任多年財務長的代理執行長克雷斯（Colette Kress）領導。在會議中，董事長瓊斯（Harvey Jones）試圖安撫投資人，確認董事會一致接受黃仁勳的辭職，且沒有計畫讓他回任。在此之前，公眾對此事的猜測不斷，甚至有支持者發起了「支持黃仁勳」的活動。

paragraphs.en: Despite the leadership drama, Nvidia reported very strong financial results. According to NPR Business, the company earned over $115 billion in revenue during the most recent quarter. This represents a growth of more than 100 percent compared to the same time last year. Much of this success comes from the company’s data center business, which alone brought in over $100 billion. The company also shared a positive outlook for next year, raising its revenue projection to 75 percent. These figures show that the company’s core business remains very healthy, even as the firm deals with significant internal changes.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管領導層出現變動，輝達仍繳出了非常亮眼的財務成績。根據美國國家公共廣播電台（NPR）商業頻道的報導，該公司在最近一季的營收超過一千一百五十億美元，與去年同期相比成長超過百分之百。這項成就很大程度上歸功於該公司的資料中心業務，單此一項就帶來了超過一千億美元的營收。公司也對明年抱持樂觀態度，將營收預測調升至百分之七十五。這些數據顯示，儘管公司面臨重大的內部變動，其核心業務依然非常穩健。

paragraphs.en: Jensen Huang stepped down after reports surfaced about his personal life. According to NPR Business, Huang apologized for being unfaithful to his wife. Reports from The New York Times suggested that one of his affairs involved a woman who ran a company in Singapore that purchased Nvidia chips. There were also claims that this woman was suspected of being recruited by a Chinese spy agency, though NPR has not independently confirmed these reports. Following these events, the situation has become a matter of national security. According to NPR News, the Trump administration is now under pressure to explain how some of America’s most advanced artificial intelligence chips were allowed to reach China.
paragraphs.zh: 黃仁勳是在有關其私生活的報導浮出檯面後辭職的。根據 NPR 商業頻道的報導，黃仁勳為自己對婚姻不忠致歉。《紐約時報》（The New York Times）的報導指出，他其中一段婚外情涉及一名在新加坡經營公司的女子，該公司曾採購輝達的晶片。此外也有說法稱，該名女子被懷疑遭到中國情報機構吸收，儘管 NPR 尚未獨立證實這些報導。隨著這些事件發展，情況已演變成國家安全問題。根據 NPR 新聞報導，川普（Donald Trump）政府目前面臨壓力，必須解釋美國最先進的人工智慧晶片是如何被允許流入中國的。

paragraphs.en: Even with these serious challenges, industry experts suggest that Nvidia is in a unique position. The Verge reports that the company is so profitable that it makes roughly $700 million in profit every day. Because the company is so successful, leadership is focused on keeping the business stable. Colette Kress told investors that the company’s goals remain the same, emphasizing that their commitment to customers and partners will not change. She also promised to return more money to shareholders, signaling that the company intends to stay focused on its financial performance.
paragraphs.zh: 即便面臨這些嚴峻挑戰，產業專家認為輝達仍處於獨特的地位。科技媒體 The Verge 報導指出，該公司獲利能力極強，每天約可賺進七億美元。由於公司表現如此成功，領導層目前的重點在於維持業務穩定。克雷斯向投資人表示，公司的目標保持不變，並強調他們對客戶與合作夥伴的承諾不會改變。她也承諾會將更多資金回饋給股東，顯示公司打算繼續專注於財務表現。

paragraphs.en: While some might worry that a leadership crisis could damage a company, Nvidia’s current situation is different. The Verge notes that the company is so large and its products are so important to the current artificial intelligence boom that it faces very little real competition from other chipmakers. While the company’s market value dropped from about $5 trillion to $3.6 trillion following the scandal, it remains a giant in the tech world. The company’s ability to generate massive amounts of cash means it has the resources to handle these problems without needing to change its overall business strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然有些人擔心領導危機可能會損害公司，但輝達目前的情況有所不同。The Verge 指出，該公司規模龐大，且其產品對當前的人工智慧熱潮至關重要，因此幾乎沒有面臨來自其他晶片製造商的實質競爭。儘管在醜聞爆發後，該公司的市值從約五兆美元跌至三點六兆美元，但它在科技界仍是巨頭。該公司產生巨額現金的能力，意味著它有足夠的資源來處理這些問題，而無需改變其整體商業策略。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the company is trying to project a sense of normalcy. During the earnings call, Kress told listeners that the team is ready to move forward, ending the meeting by saying, "We've got this." Meanwhile, Jensen Huang has expressed a willingness to return to his role. He posted on social media that he has received many calls from employees and business partners asking him to come back, and an online petition supporting his return has gathered nearly 200,000 names. However, the board’s clear message is that they are moving on without him.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，公司正試圖展現一切如常的氛圍。在財報電話會議中，克雷斯告訴聽眾團隊已準備好繼續前進，並以「我們能搞定」這句話結束會議。與此同時，黃仁勳已表達願意重返職位的意願。他在社群媒體上發文表示，已接到許多員工與商業夥伴的電話要求他回歸，且一份支持他回任的線上連署已收集了近二十萬個簽名。然而，董事會傳達的訊息很明確，他們將在沒有他的情況下繼續前進。

paragraphs.en: Ultimately, Nvidia is a company caught between massive financial success and difficult political and personal challenges. While the board of directors remains firm on its decision regarding the former CEO, the company must also address the concerns of the government regarding its international sales. For now, the focus is on maintaining the high profits that have made Nvidia a central part of the global economy. Whether the company can continue this level of growth while managing these complex issues remains the biggest question for investors and the tech industry as a whole.
paragraphs.zh: 總結來說，輝達是一家夾在巨大財務成功與棘手政治及個人挑戰之間的公司。雖然董事會對於前執行長的決定立場堅定，但公司也必須處理政府對於其國際銷售的疑慮。目前，重點在於維持讓輝達成為全球經濟核心的高獲利能力。該公司在管理這些複雜問題的同時，能否維持這種成長水準，仍是投資人與整個科技產業最大的疑問。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To resign or leave a position of authority or responsibility.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見於描述職位變動，這裡指執行長離職。文中：Jensen Huang stepped down after reports surfaced about his personal life.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To become known or be revealed after being hidden or unknown.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 浮出水面、被揭露、為人所知。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（表面），這裡作動詞指消息被公開。文中：Jensen Huang stepped down after reports surfaced about his personal life.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To continue with one's life or activities after a difficult event or change.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 繼續前進、翻開新的一頁（不再糾結於過去）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡指公司決定不再考慮前任執行長。文中：However, the board’s clear message is that they are moving on without him.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Unchanging and determined; not likely to be altered.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（公司），這裡作形容詞描述態度。文中：While the board of directors remains firm on its decision regarding the former CEO, the company must also address the concerns of the government regarding its international sales.

quiz.question: What specific action did the board chairman take during the earnings call regarding Jensen Huang?

options.A: He announced that the board was considering rehiring Huang due to public pressure.
options.B: He confirmed that the board unanimously agreed to accept the resignation and would not bring him back.
options.C: He apologized to shareholders for the recent drop in the company's market value.
options.D: He promised to launch an internal investigation into the allegations against the former CEO.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，董事長 Harvey Jones 在財報會議上明確表示董事會一致通過了黃仁勳的辭職，並且沒有計畫讓他回任。選項 A 與文意相反；選項 C 雖然提到市場價值下降，但並非董事長在會議上的主要回應；選項 D 文中並未提及董事會要進行調查，而是強調董事會已決定向前看。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why is Nvidia's business strategy unlikely to change despite the recent scandals?

options.A: Because the interim CEO has full support from Jensen Huang to continue his original plans.
options.B: Because the government has guaranteed that there will be no investigations into their sales.
options.C: Because the company's massive profitability and dominant market position provide a buffer against internal crises.
options.D: Because the board of directors is planning to rehire Huang once the political situation settles.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第五段，Nvidia 擁有極高的獲利能力（每天七億美元）且在 AI 市場幾乎沒有競爭對手，這使得他們即便面臨醜聞，也有足夠資源維持既有策略。選項 A 不正確，因為董事會已明確拒絕黃回任；選項 B 與文中提到的國家安全疑慮矛盾；選項 D 完全違背了董事會「向前看」的立場。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the word 'maintaining' mean in the context of the sentence: 'For now, the focus is on maintaining the high profits that have made Nvidia a central part of the global economy'?

options.A: Increasing the profits by a significant percentage.
options.B: Keeping the current level of high profits stable.
options.C: Repairing the damage caused by the recent leadership crisis.
options.D: Reporting the financial data to the government accurately.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。Maintain 在此處的意思是「維持、保持」，意指讓現有的高獲利狀態持續下去，而非增加（Increase）。選項 A 的增加屬於成長（Growth）範疇；選項 C 的修復與該詞原意不符；選項 D 的報告並非 maintaining 的語意重點。文章強調公司目前的核心目標是穩定現狀。

quiz.question: Which of the following best summarizes the central message of the article?

options.A: Nvidia is struggling to survive after the sudden resignation of its long-time leader.
options.B: The US government is planning to take over Nvidia due to national security concerns.
options.C: Nvidia faces significant leadership and political challenges but remains financially strong and stable.
options.D: Jensen Huang is likely to return to his CEO position because of the strong support from his employees.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。這篇文章的核心在於探討 Nvidia 在經歷執行長醜聞與政治壓力（國家安全）的同時，仍維持強勁的財務表現與市場主導地位。選項 A 過度誇大公司的困境；選項 B 並非文章主旨，僅是其中一個挑戰；選項 D 雖然提到員工支持，但文章最後強調董事會立場堅定，並未暗示他會回任。
